meta.title: Updating a technical answer merges data and keeps remarks unless they are changed
gaps: No setup recipe creates a draft technical answer with sections A and B filled, an existing remark, a masked round with two responding vendors, or a service-grouped RFP with two activities in one service.
No operation or library case updates or submits an existing technical answer, so merging section data and clearing remarks cannot be tested.
No operation or assertion can verify that the remark is cleared after submission.
